title: Deferred bridge runway and risk simulator for air-gapped private onboarding
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: We routinely receive private/VPC/on‑prem intake requests where customers report vague 'network/upgrade' constraints. Current triage is manual, slow (days), and produces inconsistent remediation lists. That increases onboarding time, engineering touch hours, and risk during upgrades.

Goal: Ship an intake augmentation called 'Deferred Bridge Runway & Risk Simulator' — a decisioning pipeline that consumes customer-reported network posture (connectivity matrix, allowed egress, proxy/bastion patterns, patch window constraints) and returns: 1) an automated risk score, 2) an estimated runway to pass internal preflight checks, and 3) a prioritized remediation playbook with staged remediation artifacts the customer can execute.

Key ideas:
- Non-invasive simulation: instead of running active probes against customer infra, we run sandboxed, parameterized upgrade/egress simulations using a library of common network topologies and a small set of synthetic traffic models.
- Deferred bridge concept: for high-risk customers we propose a temporary 'deferred bridge' remediation — a short-lived, minimal-exposure bastion/proxy template plus an explicit rollback plan; the system will generate an automated template and steps for Solutions Eng to share with the customer.
- Risk simulator: ingest sample outputs (allowed ports, NAT behavior, TLS inspection, egress gating) and run a deterministic rule engine + stochastic pathfinder that simulates upgrade attempts and surfaces likely failure modes (DNS, MTU, TLS handshake, proxy auth).
- Scoring and SLA suggestions: produce a single-page summary with risk band (Low/Medium/High), suggested SLA profile (e.g., require Dedicated fastlane, manual schedule, or cannot proceed without network changes), and expected engineering effort (hours).

Out-of-scope for MVP: active customer-side probing without explicit consent, full automated remediation rollouts, RBAC integration into customer's IdP.

Deliverables:
- Data ingest schema for customer network posture (YAML/JSON template).
- Sandbox risk simulator service and UI summary card in Console onboarding flow.
- Deferred bridge templated artifact (bastion + iptables/proxy snippet + rollback script).
- Triage playbook for Solutions Eng with suggested next steps and escalation paths.

Acceptance criteria (see field): when given a typical customer intake form, system returns a risk score + remediation playbook within 20 minutes for >90% of test cases and reduces manual triage time by 50% in pilot.

Risks & trade-offs:
- Privacy/Legal: even sandboxed simulations could require customer data; we will store only normalized posture data and treat any customer-provided artifacts as sensitive.
- False negatives: simulations might not cover exotic proxy setups; mitigation is to flag 'unknowns' and require manual review.
- UX complexity: adding another automated decision might confuse CS/SE; we will add an explicit override and 'why we scored this' trace.

Stakeholders: PM (Asha), Solutions Engineering (Omar Ruiz), Infra/Runtime (Priya Menon), Security/Privacy (Rory Chen), Console UX (Sofia Martinez).
acceptance_criteria: Known-input test set (20 canonical network postures) yields risk score and remediation playbook within 20 minutes for 18/20 cases
Pilot with 5 customer intakes reduces manual engineering triage steps by >=50% vs baseline
Console displays a one-page summary card and links to a generated deferred bridge artifact for Solutions Eng to share
Security review signoff obtained and customer data retention policy documented
Automation must explicitly require customer consent before any active probe or shared artifact application
comments: 2025-02-12 - Kickoff: Reviewed intake pain points with SE team. Agreement to prioritize non-invasive simulation first.
2025-02-20 - Tech spike complete: runtime team built a lightweight pathfinder prototype that models TCP/TLS failure modes. Early results show good coverage for common proxies.
2025-02-24 - Legal flagged data retention & consent flow; requirement added: explicit checkbox in intake form and transient tokenization of any network artifacts.
2025-02-28 - UX review: Sofia requested an explainer panel that shows which rules fired in the risk simulator; added to scope as 'trace view'.

2025-03-03 - Decision: Defer active customer probing until explicit consent. MVP will ship with sandbox simulations + deferred bridge template generation. Next: build schema and run pilot with 3 customers (CS intro planned week of 2025-03-17).
